profile: regularization: A complementary approach to feature selection. Instead of building up a model from the bottom, regularization takes a top-down view: it starts with a complete model that includes all input features and gradually removes features of inferior importance. This top-down approach is generally referred to in machine learning jargon as a regularization strategy. A related term is regularizer-based regularization. Along with boosting, regularization is one of two popular ways for performing feature selection.
